name: Maya Bennett
bio: Landscape designer and weekend trail explorer. My perfect Sunday starts with a sunrise walk and ends with homemade pasta. Looking for kindness, curiosity, and a real connection.

name: Isla Reed
bio: Art curator with a soft spot for little galleries and big conversations. Tell me about the place you would visit twice. Looking for someone thoughtful with a playful side.

name: Amara Patel
bio: Avid reader, product designer, and enthusiastic beginner at pottery. I love quiet bookshops as much as a spontaneous city break. Here for a meaningful relationship.

name: Hana Park
bio: Photographer collecting everyday moments and new recipes. Usually planning a coastal walk or finding the best noodles in town. A good sense of humour goes a long way.

name: Sofia Costa
bio: Marine biologist happiest beside the ocean. Equally up for a beach clean-up, live music, or cooking dinner together. Looking for an adventurous partner with a warm heart.

name: Naomi Brooks
bio: Illustrator, bass player, and iced-coffee enthusiast. I know a great record shop and an even better brunch spot. Hoping to meet someone creative and down to earth.

name: Adrian Cole
bio: Chef by trade, trail explorer by choice. I make excellent pancakes and take terrible victory photos at the summit. Looking for someone to share the little everyday adventures.

name: Rohan Silva
bio: Software engineer who closes the laptop for live music, weekend runs, and a proper cup of coffee. I value honesty, family, and a relationship we can both grow in.

name: Julian Hayes
bio: Architect with a weakness for jazz bars and second-hand bookstores. Happiest sketching a new place or making dinner for friends. Seeking a lasting connection.

name: Luca Martin
bio: Outdoor guide and enthusiastic amateur surfer. Give me sea air, a good playlist, and someone to laugh with. Looking for a kind partner who enjoys an active life.

name: Kai Chen
bio: Physiotherapist, weekend cyclist, and dedicated dumpling researcher. I enjoy staying active but will always stop for a good sunset. Here for easy conversation and something real.

name: Elias Grant
bio: Entrepreneur who makes time for tennis, slow travel, and long dinners with friends. Looking for someone emotionally open, curious, and ready to build something meaningful.
